contents.html: A noisemaker costs 43 cents. Do you have enough money to buy it?
A noisemaker costs 43 cents. Do you have enough money to buy it?

content.html:
Count the money.




First, count the quarters by counting by twenty-fives: 25¢.


Then, count the dimes by counting up by tens: 35¢.


Then, count the nickels by counting up by fives: 40¢.


Now count the pennies by counting up by ones: 41¢, 42¢, 43¢, 44¢.

You have 44¢. You have more than 43¢. You have enough money to buy a noisemaker.
